rounds.ai_message: Chen, Daniel here. Look — before we cut a single program, I have to push back on your spec. You're asking for an E14 machine, 24-cut equivalent gauge, with 12-zone body mapping and engineered compression for a 'plus-size sculpting' legging at a US$6.50 target retail. E14 is too coarse for that construction density at the price point. You'll get a boardy hand and visible stitch pattern, not the smooth second-skin the buyer wants. Let me lay out the real options.
rounds.ai_message_zh: Chen, Daniel。开程序前我得先 push back。你要 E14 机、12 区塑形、加压工艺,做大码塑形打底裤,零售目标 6.5 美元。E14 在这个价格点对这种密度太粗。布会板结、针迹明显,不是客户要的第二层皮肤。让我列真方案。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 理解技术挑战,讨论真方案
rounds.common_mistakes: E14 是粗针机,适合冬季厚款;12 区 body mapping 需要更细的 E28 或 E32。
rounds.tips_zh: E14 + 12 区塑形是矛盾组合,机器精度不够做细分区。
rounds.user_response_example: Lay them out, Daniel. The US$6.50 retail is fixed by the buyer's merchandising team. We need to find the right machine and construction to hit the price and the design intent.

rounds.ai_message: Three real paths. Path A: E28 with 4 zones (waist, hip, mid-thigh, calf) at 200-260 GSM — the proven construction for sculpting leggings. Hits the price, fits the look, but only 4 zones. Path B: E24 with 6 zones, slightly boardier hand than E28, but more body mapping. Path C: stay E14, drop to 6 zones, accept the visible texture. Your call on the trade.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 三个真方案。A:E28,4 区(腰、臀、中腿、小腿),200-260 克 — 经典塑形打底裤,价格、效果都达标,只有 4 区。B:E24,6 区,手感比 E28 略硬,但分区更多。C:保持 E14,降到 6 区,接受明显纹理。你怎么选?
rounds.common_mistakes: 4-zone 经典分区:腰 / 臀 / 中腿 / 小腿,足以体现塑形感;6+ 区更精细但成本上升。
rounds.tips_zh: 分区数不等于塑形效果,4 区经典方案在运动品牌里已验证。
rounds.user_response_example: Path A. E28 with 4 zones is the right proven construction. 4 zones is enough for the sculpting story. Let's lock the spec there and optimize the price.

rounds.ai_message: Path A confirmed. E28, 4 zones. Now the engineering — the sculpting claim needs to be backed by measured compression, not just marketing. We can run a compression test on the fabric at 30% elongation, target around 15-18 mmHg for 'firm' sculpting. That requires a tighter stitch length and higher spandex content. What's the buyer's compression claim in the marketing — light, firm, or extra-firm?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 方案 A 确认。E28,4 区。工程上 — 塑形要靠压缩数据支撑,不是营销话术。我们可在 30% 拉伸下测压力,目标 15-18 mmHg 是'强塑形'。这需要更短线圈长度、更高氨纶。客户营销口径是什么 — 轻压、强压、还是超强压?
rounds.common_mistakes: mmHg(毫米汞柱) 是压缩压力单位,15-18 是中强压,18-22 是强压,22+ 是医疗级。
rounds.tips_zh: 运动打底裤一般 15-22 mmHg,医疗级 20-30 mmHg,客户营销要准确,不能夸大。
rounds.user_response_example: Firm sculpting, but the marketing team hasn't put a number on it. I'll align with you at 15-18 mmHg at 30% elongation. Document the test method in the spec so we can defend the claim if needed.

rounds.ai_message: Test method is HATRA or MST Stretch Recovery — we use MST because it's more repeatable. 15-18 mmHg is achievable on E28 with 30% spandex. But here's the trade — at that compression, the recovery at 100% elongation drops to 88-90%. Recovery is what makes a legging 'last'. The buyer should know that 'firm' and 'durable recovery' are slightly opposed. Are they willing to accept 90% recovery, or do they need 92%+?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 测试方法用 HATRA 或 MST Stretch Recovery,我们用 MST 重复性更好。E28 + 30% 氨纶,15-18 mmHg 能做到。但这里有取舍 — 在那个压力下,100% 拉伸回弹降到 88-90%。回弹是打底裤耐穿的关键。客户能接受 90%,还是要 92%+?
rounds.common_mistakes: stretch recovery(拉伸回弹) 是氨纶布耐用度核心指标,100% 拉伸后回弹,数值越高越耐穿。
rounds.tips_zh: 压缩压力越高,回弹越低;90% 是底线,92% 是性能级,95% 是顶级。
rounds.user_response_example: The buyer is targeting 92% recovery — that's a performance promise in the marketing. Can we hit 92% at 15-18 mmHg? If not, we have to relax the compression claim. Walk me through the options.

rounds.ai_message: 92% recovery at 15-18 mmHg is achievable, but we need to drop the nylon from 40D to 30D and increase spandex from 20D to 30D. That adds US$0.22 per garment but pushes the recovery to 93% and keeps compression in the 15-18 range. Also, the spandex needs to be Creora brand or equivalent high-recovery grade — generic spandex lands at 88-89%.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 92% 回弹 + 15-18 mmHg 可以做到,但要把锦纶从 40D 降到 30D,氨纶从 20D 加到 30D。加 0.22 美元一件,但回弹推到 93%,压缩保持 15-18。此外氨纶要用 Creora 或同级高回弹品牌 — 普通氨纶只到 88-89%。
rounds.common_mistakes: Creora(韩国晓星)氨纶是高回弹品牌,优于普通氨纶,价格高 20-30%。
rounds.tips_zh: 无缝高性能打底裤常用 Creora / Lycra 等品牌氨纶。
rounds.user_response_example: Creora 30D is in line with the performance story. The US$0.22 premium is absorbable. Confirm Creora or equivalent in the spec, and let's move on to the size run.

rounds.ai_message: Creora 30D / nylon 30D confirmed. Now the size run — plus-size sculpting means we need to validate the 4 zones still work at 2XL and 3XL. The compression is in the fabric, but the body mapping was designed on a medium frame. We should test fit on a 2XL fit model before committing to the size run. Can you arrange that?
rounds.ai_message_zh: Creora 30D / 锦纶 30D 确认。尺码方面 — 大码塑形要验证 2XL、3XL 下 4 区是否仍有效。压力在布里,但 body mapping 是按中码身材设计的。要在 2XL fit model 上试身,再定尺码组。你能安排吗?
rounds.common_mistakes: plus-size(大码) 在外贸里通常指 2XL+,欧美市场 14-24 码,需要专门的 fit model。
rounds.tips_zh: 大码 fit model 在国内难找,常借用 brand 总部 fit model 或视频连线。
rounds.user_response_example: The buyer's US office has a fit model program. I'll arrange a video fitting for 2XL and 3XL on the proto. Can you have the proto ready in two sizes by week 3? It'll cost extra but it's the right call.

rounds.ai_message: Two-size proto in M and 2XL by week 3 — doable, no extra charge. We can include a 'compression map' printout showing the mmHg at each of the 4 zones for both sizes. That data will help the buyer's product team defend the claim. About the lead time for the full size run after fit approval — 6,000 pieces across 5 sizes, with 4-zone programming, expect 35 days.
rounds.ai_message_zh: M 和 2XL 两码产前样第 3 周出 — 可行,不另收费。我们会附一份'压力图',显示两个尺码 4 区的 mmHg。数据帮客户产品团队证明卖点。fit 批准后,6 千件 5 尺码、4 区编程,35 天出货。
rounds.common_mistakes: compression map(压力图) 是工程文件,标明各区 mmHg,营销和合规都能用。
rounds.tips_zh: 营销要塑形卖点,工程要有数据支撑,压力图是两者的桥梁。
rounds.user_response_example: Compression map is a great idea — that's the kind of data the buyer's product team loves. 35 days is fine. Send the proto with the map, and I'll have the buyer's product team review by week 4.

rounds.ai_message: Final package: E28, 4 zones (200-260 GSM), Creora 30D / nylon 30D, 80/20 nylon-spandex, 15-18 mmHg at 30% elongation, 92%+ recovery, plus-size fit validation on 2XL, compression map deliverable, full size run 6,000 pieces in 35 days. PI tomorrow at US$5.10 per piece, including the engineering and validation work. Let's lock it.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 最终方案:E28,4 区(200-260 克),Creora 30D / 锦纶 30D,80/20 锦纶氨纶,30% 拉伸下 15-18 mmHg,92%+ 回弹,2XL 大码验证,附压力图,5 尺码 6 千件 35 天出货。PI 明天发,5.10 美元一件,含工程和验证。锁定。
rounds.common_mistakes: 工程和验证费是隐形成本,要写进 PI,客户才能在总成本里看到。
rounds.tips_zh: PI 要列所有加价项(氨纶升级、压力图、大码验证),让客户逐条确认。
rounds.user_response_example: Locked, Daniel. Send the PI to chen.wei@lilygarments.com with the engineering and validation line items clearly visible. The compression map is a real differentiator for the buyer. Approved and looking forward to the proto.
